name: Sheep
report: The balanceOf() function returns reflection-adjusted balances that depend on _tTotal, which is reduced by _burn(). Since the liquidity pool address was not excluded from reflections, an attacker manipulated the token price by burning tokens via flash loans, causing artificial price inflation and enabling profitable swaps.
report_zh: balanceOf() 函数返回依赖 _tTotal 的反射调整余额，而 _tTotal 通过 _burn() 减少。由于流动性池地址未从反射中排除，攻击者通过闪电贷销毁代币来操纵代币价格，造成人为的价格膨胀，从而实现获利交换。
